name: Counter Charge
body:
You can quickly bring your braced weapon to bear upon a charging foe.

Prerequisites: Combat Reflexes, Proficiency with brace weapon, Base Attack+6.

Benefit: If you are not flat-footed and may make an attack of opportunity and are wielding a weapon with the brace feature, you may set the weapon for a charge as an immediate action to make an attack of opportunity. If the charging opponent has a reach weapon and your weapon is not a reach weapon, you may not effectively employ the actions of this feat.

Normal: Bracing a weapon against a charge requires you to ready an action.
